en_title: "As Far as I'm Concerned, That's a Step in the Right Direction" – Path of Exile Dev Optimistic About Diablo 5
cn_title: 《流放之路》前开发者谨慎看好《暗黑破坏神5》
subtitle: 借鉴经典，也要面向当下
opus_summary: 《流放之路》开发商GGG的前联合创始人Chris Wilson谨慎看好《暗黑破坏神5》借鉴《暗黑破坏神2》的方向，但认为新作不必完全回归旧作设计。他还预计游戏可能赶不上2029年春季发售。

paragraphs.en: While Diablo 5 was announced at Blizzcon 2026 just a couple weeks ago, the game doesn't come out until Spring 2029. But it seems like Chris Wilson, former co-founder of Path of Exile developer Grinding Gear Games, is tentatively excited for Blizzard's next ARPG.
paragraphs.cn: 《暗黑破坏神5》虽然才在几周前的2026年暴雪嘉年华上公布，但要到2029年春季才会发售。不过，《流放之路》开发商GGG的前联合创始人Chris Wilson似乎已经对暴雪这款动作角色扮演新作抱有谨慎的期待。

paragraphs.en: Wilson, who left Grinding Gear Games in 2023, released a video over the weekend where he broke down everything Blizzard has announced about the upcoming Diablo game, from its story to itemization and monster levels. And while he did have some nitpicks, it seems like he's cautiously optimistic that the Diablo series is headed in the right direction, because of the influence the seminal Diablo 2 seems to have on it so far.
paragraphs.cn: Wilson于2023年离开GGG。他在周末发布了一段视频，逐一分析暴雪目前公布的《暗黑破坏神5》信息，涉及剧情、装备系统和怪物等级等方面。尽管他也挑出了一些小毛病，但从目前披露的内容来看，这款游戏似乎深受经典之作《暗黑破坏神2》影响，因此他谨慎地认为，系列正在朝正确的方向前进。

paragraphs.en: Wilson is particularly fond of the new character and inventory screen, where items once again boast different sizes, along with stats that are more in line with Diablo 2. However, there are some modern choices, such as a flat DPS number on weapons, that rub him the wrong way. Still, he recognizes that Diablo 5 can't fully embrace Diablo 2's at-times clunky design.
paragraphs.cn: Wilson尤其喜欢新的角色与物品栏界面：物品再次有了不同的尺寸，属性设定也更接近《暗黑破坏神2》。不过，武器直接显示DPS数值等现代化设计让他不太满意。即便如此，他也明白，《暗黑破坏神5》不能照搬《暗黑破坏神2》有时显得笨拙的设计。

paragraphs.en: "There's a bigger question if they're going to go all the way and risk alienating the modern audience that they've cultivated over the last couple of decades," he said. "I don't think they necessarily should. While selfishly it'd be amazing for them to make a new version of Diablo 2 just for me, I don't think they could justify an investment of that size for a game with a niche audience."
paragraphs.cn: 他说：「更大的问题是，他们是否要彻底回归旧作，冒着疏远过去几十年培养起来的现代玩家群体的风险。我觉得他们未必应该这么做。私心来说，如果他们专门为我做一款新版《暗黑破坏神2》，那当然棒极了，但我不认为他们能为一款受众有限的游戏投入那么多资金。」

paragraphs.en: Instead, Wilson expects that Diablo V will try to adopt the best of both worlds, with a "modern ARPG that borrows heavily from Diablo 2, rather than a true return to the design philosophy of Diablo 2."
paragraphs.cn: Wilson预计，《暗黑破坏神5》会尝试兼顾新旧两种设计，做成「一款大量借鉴《暗黑破坏神2》的现代动作角色扮演游戏，而不是真正回归《暗黑破坏神2》的设计理念」。

paragraphs.en: But even though the game is still a couple years away, according to Blizzard, Wilson thinks Diablo 5 is going to end up delayed. He says, "my best guess is the game won't be ready for spring 2029, but that's ok, delays happen and are normal in this industry. I can't count the amount of times I had to delay a Path of Exile League release and players were okay with it."
paragraphs.cn: 暴雪公布的发售时间还有几年，但Wilson认为《暗黑破坏神5》最终仍会延期。他说：「我猜游戏赶不上2029年春季发售，不过没关系，延期在这个行业很常见。我都数不清自己推迟过多少次《流放之路》赛季的上线时间了，玩家也都能接受。」

paragraphs.en: If anything, delaying Diablo 5 would give Diablo 4 more room to breathe. Just like a lot of players, Wilson feels like the early announcement of D5 is a sign that Blizzard is abandoing Diablo 4 – even if Blizzard itself has denied that in an interview with PC Gamer . Instead, Blizzard is going to keep developing the story with new seasons, the latest of which is a 30-year celebration of the franchise.
paragraphs.cn: 真要延期，倒是能给《暗黑破坏神4》留下更多发展空间。和不少玩家一样，Wilson觉得暴雪这么早公布《暗黑破坏神5》，像是打算放弃《暗黑破坏神4》，尽管暴雪在接受PC Gamer采访时否认了这一点。暴雪表示会继续通过新赛季推进剧情，最近推出的赛季便以系列诞生30周年为主题。

paragraphs.en: I've already spent almost 50 hours in Season 15 alone, and have been having a blast with all the nostalgic content Blizzard added this time around. Chris Wilson is less amused by it, saying, "to be honest, this event feels pretty distasteful to me," because "Diablo 4 was slowly building up to you being able to fight all the prime evils, then they introduce them all at once in a special event that isn't really tied to the games story."
paragraphs.cn: 光是第15赛季，我就已经玩了将近50小时，暴雪这次加入的怀旧内容也让我玩得很尽兴。Chris Wilson却没那么喜欢。他说：「老实说，我觉得这次活动让人不太舒服。」原因是「《暗黑破坏神4》本来在慢慢铺垫，让玩家最终能够与所有至高邪神交战，结果他们却在一场与游戏剧情没什么关系的特别活动中，一口气把它们全放了出来」。

paragraphs.en: Regardless, new seasons will continue to filter out to Diablo 4 over the next year and a half. Blizzard will also be adding Diablo 2's Amazon class to the game in a DLC pack early next year. Speaking of classes, the company has also revealed a handful of the classes coming to Diablo 5 , and that at launch the new game will apparently have more classes available than in any previous Diablo game. I'm just hoping they bring back the Demon Hunter from Diablo 3 .
paragraphs.cn: 不管怎样，接下来一年半里，《暗黑破坏神4》仍会陆续推出新赛季。暴雪还将在明年年初通过DLC为游戏加入《暗黑破坏神2》的亚马逊职业。说到职业，暴雪也公布了《暗黑破坏神5》的几个职业；新作首发时可选的职业数量似乎会超过系列任何前作。我只希望《暗黑破坏神3》的猎魔人也能回归。
